change.after: "empty environment variables are passed to plugins as ARGOCD_ENV_\u003cNAME\u003e=\"\""

consequence.statement: Plugin env entries with empty values are now passed to the plugin as empty environment variables, which may change plugin behavior.

assertion.statement: In Argo CD 3.0, plugin env entries with empty values are now passed to config management plugins (e.g. ARGOCD_ENV_DATA="") instead of being omitted.
